formal_statement.plain_language: For each entry of the Method B off-diagonal inverse block, the computed product and lower-triangular solve jointly yield the paper’s componentwise right-residual estimate.

informal_proof: The paper combines the rounded block-product relation with the triangular solve backward-error relation, rearranges the off-diagonal block equation, and adds their componentwise bounds.
informal_statement: The rounded Method B product followed by a lower-triangular solve leaves an off-diagonal right residual bounded by the sum of the two componentwise rounding-error terms.
paper_version: published journal version; SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 16(2), 1995, printed pages 400-413

tier_rationale: The L proof invokes two distinct substantial frozen theorems, matMul_error_bound and forwardSub_backward_error. Its 127-line construction bridges the paper-scoped operations and combines their bounds. N independently reconstructs both rounded-algorithm analyses in 1074 lines before making the same combination. Mathlib has no ready floating-point theorem for either algorithm, and this Method B composition is not a frozen library theorem.
